name: Warrior Kinship
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
<The Hero looks you over.>

You are a champion, no doubt.  I would ask an honorable task of you, but I must test your strength.

It is said that Rexxar would measure the sharpness of his blades by killing a helboar with a single, swift strike.  Now I will measure your strength by killing them.
narrative.objectives: Kill 7 Helboar in the Blasted Lands and return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
narrative.offerRewardText: I need no proof to know what you have done, warrior.  I can see the determination etched in your expression.
narrative.requestItemsText: The burning spines of the helboar leave horrific scars. Do not fear the pain and disfigurement, warrior, they are nothing compared to the prison to which I am bound.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests at level 52, 17,050 XP in all.

quests.name: A Troubled Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Speak with the Fallen Hero of the Horde at the entrance to the Blasted Lands.

quests.name: Warrior Kinship
quests.objectiveText: Kill 7 Helboar in the Blasted Lands and return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

quests.name: War on the Shadowsworn
quests.objectiveText: Slaughter the Shadowsworn in the Blasted Lands and return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

quests.name: Voodoo Feathers
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Voodoo Feathers from the trolls in the Sunken Temple to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
